role: next-word suggestions and two-letter completion, plus byte-level scoring
architecture: Minimal Inference Cellular Automaton with learned integer rewrite rules, quantized integer readout, an integer memory sidecar, and integer word readouts over the existing 240 cellular probes
training: automaton: Codex native refit 097b3acc + 60 live fit rounds with readout and rule immediates averaged (stochastic weight averaging); then joint readout + memory refit on exact integer probe states of 119,823 train-only records (eswa_joint_ep4_avg); word heads trained on the same records (v8192_avg2-4)
selection: dev2 first 500 records per domain (bytes) and dev2 word prompts (words); never the clean sets
confirmation: dev2 last 500 records per domain once; clean chat/everyday val1000 reported once
